title: Trigonometry
syllabus: Trigonometrical identities and trigonometrical functions, inverse trigonometrical functions, and their properties.

body: A point at angle θ on the unit circle is (cos θ, sin θ); tan θ = \f{sin θ}{cos θ}.
Signs by quadrant — I: all +, II: sin +, III: tan +, IV: cos +.
sin^{2}θ + cos^{2}θ = 1, 1 + tan^{2}θ = sec^{2}θ, 1 + cot^{2}θ = cosec^{2}θ.

sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A; cos 2A = 1 − 2sin^{2}A = 2cos^{2}A − 1; sin 3A = 3 sin A − 4sin^{3}A; cos 3A = 4cos^{3}A − 3 cos A.

sin^{−1}x + cos^{−1}x = \f{π}{2}; tan^{−1}x + cot^{−1}x = \f{π}{2}; sin^{−1}(sin θ) = θ only when θ is in the principal range.
tan^{−1}a ± tan^{−1}b = tan^{−1}\f{a ± b}{1 ∓ ab} (when ab < 1 for +). Telescoping: \f{(k + 1) − k}{1 + k(k + 1)}.
sin x = sin α ⇒ x = nπ + (−1)^{n}α; cos x = cos α ⇒ x = 2nπ ± α; tan x = tan α ⇒ x = nπ + α.

pyq.q: If θ ∈ [−2π, 2π], then the number of solutions of 2√{2}cos^{2}θ + (2 − √{6})cos θ − √{3} = 0, is equal to :
sol: A quadratic in cos θ: roots cos θ = \f{√{3}}{2} and cos θ = −\f{1}{√{2}} (product −\f{√{3}}{2√{2}} ✓).
Each value of cos θ in (−1, 1) is taken twice per period, and [−2π, 2π] holds two periods: 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.

pyq.q: If y = cos(\f{π}{3} + cos^{−1}\f{x}{2}), then (x − y)^{2} + 3y^{2} is equal to ______.
sol: Let cos^{−1}\f{x}{2} = t: x = 2cos t, y = cos(\f{π}{3} + t) = \f{1}{2}cos t − \f{√{3}}{2}sin t.

pyq.q: The number of solutions of the equation 2x + 3 tan x = π, x ∈ [−2π, 2π] − {±\f{π}{2}, ±\f{3π}{2}} is:
sol: f(x) = 2x + 3 tan x − π is increasing on each piece between asymptotes, so it has at most one zero there.

pyq.q: The number of solutions of the equation (4 − √{3})sin x − 2√{3}cos^{2}x = −\f{4}{1 + √{3}}, x ∈ [−2π, \f{5π}{2}] is
Considering the principal values of the inverse trigonometric functions, sin^{−1}(\f{√{3}}{2}x + \f{1}{2}√{1 − x^{2}}), −\f{1}{2} < x < \f{1}{√{2}}, is equal to
sol: Put x = sin t, t ∈ (−\f{π}{6}, \f{π}{4}): the inside is sin t cos\f{π}{6} + cos t sin\f{π}{6} = sin(t + \f{π}{6}).
t + \f{π}{6} ∈ (0, \f{5π}{12}) lies in the principal range, so the value is \f{π}{6} + sin^{−1}x.

pyq.q: Given the inverse trigonometric function assumes principal values only. Let x, y be any two real numbers in [−1, 1] such that cos^{−1}x − sin^{−1}y = α, −\f{π}{2} ≤ α ≤ π. Then, the minimum value of x^{2} + y^{2} + 2xy sin α is
sol: x = cos A, y = sin B with α = A − B.
It equals 0 when x = y = 0 (A = \f{π}{2}, B = 0, α = \f{π}{2}): minimum 0.

pyq.q: Let S = {sin^{2}2θ : (sin^{4}θ + cos^{4}θ)x^{2} + (sin 2θ)x + (sin^{6}θ + cos^{6}θ) = 0 has real roots}. If α and β be the smallest and largest elements of the set S, respectively, then 3((α − 2)^{2} + (β − 1)^{2}) equals ______.
The number of solutions of sin^{2}x + (2 + 2x − x^{2})sin x − 3(x − 1)^{2} = 0, where −π ≤ x ≤ π, is ______.
sol: With t = (x − 1)^{2}, 2 + 2x − x^{2} = 3 − t, so the equation is (sin x + 3)(sin x − t) = 0.
The parabola touches [0, 1] only near x = 1: it meets sin x twice in [−π, π].

The number of solutions of the equation cos 2θ cos\f{θ}{2} + cos\f{5θ}{2} = 2cos^{3}\f{5θ}{2} in [−\f{π}{2}, \f{π}{2}] is :
sol: cos 2θ cos\f{θ}{2} = \f{1}{2}(cos\f{5θ}{2} + cos\f{3θ}{2}); 2cos^{3}u − cos u = \f{1}{2}(cos 3u + cos u) with u = \f{5θ}{2}.
The equation becomes cos\f{3θ}{2} + cos\f{5θ}{2} = cos\f{15θ}{2} + cos\f{5θ}{2} → cos\f{3θ}{2} = cos\f{15θ}{2}.
2 lies in (\f{π}{2}, π), so √{1 + tan^{2}2} = |sec 2| = −sec 2: the first argument is \f{−sec 2 − 1}{tan 2} = −\f{1 + cos 2}{sin 2} = −cot 1, and cot^{−1}(−cot 1) = π − 1.

pyq.q: The sum of all possible values of θ ∈ [−π, 2π], for which \f{1 + i cos θ}{1 − 2i cos θ} is purely imaginary, is equal to
sol: Multiply by the conjugate 1 + 2i cos θ: real part ∝ 1 − 2cos^{2}θ, imaginary part ∝ 3cos θ.

pyq.q: If sin x = −\f{3}{5}, where π < x < \f{3π}{2}, then 80(tan^{2}x − cos x) is equal to :
sol: Third quadrant: cos x = −\f{4}{5}, tan x = \f{3}{4}.

pyq.q: Let the inverse trigonometric functions take principal values. The number of real solutions of the equation 2 sin^{−1}x + 3 cos^{−1}x = \f{2π}{5}, is ______.
sol: 2 sin^{−1}x + 3 cos^{−1}x = π + cos^{−1}x (using sin^{−1}x + cos^{−1}x = \f{π}{2}).

Let A(6, 8), B(10 cos α, −10 sin α) and C(−10 sin α, 10 cos α), be the vertices of a triangle. If L(a, 9) and G(h, k) be its orthocenter and centroid respectively, then (5a − 3h + 6k + 100 sin 2α) is equal to ______.
sol: All three vertices are at distance 10 from O, so O is the circumcentre and H = A + B + C.
H_{y} = 8 + 10(cos α − sin α) = 9 → cos α − sin α = \f{1}{10}; squaring, sin 2α = \f{99}{100}. a = 6 + 1 = 7.

pyq.q: If \f{π}{2} ≤ x ≤ \f{3π}{4}, then cos^{−1}(\f{12}{13}cos x + \f{5}{13}sin x) is equal to
sol: With φ = tan^{−1}\f{5}{12}: cos φ = \f{12}{13}, sin φ = \f{5}{13}, so the inside is cos(x − φ).

pyq.q: The value of (sin 70°)(cot 10° cot 70° − 1) is
sol: cot 10° cot 70° − 1 = \f{cos 10° cos 70° − sin 10° sin 70°}{sin 10° sin 70°} = \f{cos 80°}{sin 10° sin 70°}.
cos 80° = sin 10°, so the product is sin 70°·\f{1}{sin 70°} = 1.

pyq.q: If for some α, β; α ≤ β, α + β = 8 and sec^{2}(tan^{−1}α) + cosec^{2}(cot^{−1}β) = 36, then α^{2} + β is ______.

sol: A: |sin x cos x| = \f{4}{π^{2}} → |sin 2x| = \f{8}{π^{2}} ≈ 0.81: four values of x in (0, π).

pyq.q: If α > β > γ > 0, then the expression cot^{−1}{β + \f{1 + β^{2}}{α − β}} + cot^{−1}{γ + \f{1 + γ^{2}}{β − γ}} + cot^{−1}{α + \f{1 + α^{2}}{γ − α}} is equal to :
sol: β + \f{1 + β^{2}}{α − β} = \f{1 + αβ}{α − β}: so the first term is cot^{−1}\f{1 + αβ}{α − β} = tan^{−1}α − tan^{−1}β; likewise the second is tan^{−1}β − tan^{−1}γ.
The third argument is negative (γ − α < 0): cot^{−1}\f{1 + αγ}{γ − α} = π + (tan^{−1}γ − tan^{−1}α).
sin^{−1}\f{56}{65} + sin^{−1}\f{33}{65}: the sines and cosines swap (56^{2} + 33^{2} = 65^{2}), so the sum is \f{π}{2}.

pyq.q: Let S = {x : cos^{−1}x = π + sin^{−1}x + sin^{−1}(2x + 1)}. Then Σ_{x ∈ S}(2x − 1)^{2} is equal to ______.
sol: Take sine of both sides: 2x + 1 = −cos(2 sin^{−1}x) = 2x^{2} − 1 → x^{2} − x − 1 = 0; the root in [−1, 0] is x = \f{1 − √{5}}{2}.

pyq.q: If A = \f{sin 3°}{cos 9°} + \f{sin 9°}{cos 27°} + \f{sin 27°}{cos 81°} and B = tan 81° − tan 3°, then \f{B}{A} is equal to ______.
sol: \f{sin θ}{cos 3θ} = \f{1}{2}(tan 3θ − tan θ), because tan 3θ − tan θ = \f{sin 2θ}{cos 3θ cos θ} = \f{2 sin θ}{cos 3θ}.

pyq.q: The number of solutions of tan^{−1}4x + tan^{−1}6x = \f{π}{6}, where −\f{1}{2√{6}} < x < \f{1}{2√{6}}, is equal to
sol: \f{10x}{1 − 24x^{2}} = \f{1}{√{3}} → 24x^{2} + 10√{3}x − 1 = 0; only the positive root lies in the range.

pyq.q: If \f{cos^{2}48° − sin^{2}12°}{sin^{2}24° − sin^{2}6°} = \f{α + β√{5}}{2}, where α, β ∈ ℕ, then α + β is equal to ______.
sol: cos^{2}A − sin^{2}B = cos(A + B)cos(A − B) = cos 60° cos 36°; sin^{2}A − sin^{2}B = sin(A + B)sin(A − B) = sin 30° sin 18°.

pyq.q: max_{0 ≤ x ≤ π}(16 sin(\f{x}{2})cos^{3}(\f{x}{2})) is equal to:
sol: With t = \f{x}{2} ∈ [0, \f{π}{2}], maximise sin t cos^{3}t: derivative cos^{2}t(cos^{2}t − 3 sin^{2}t) = 0 → tan t = \f{1}{√{3}}, t = \f{π}{6}.

pyq.q: Let cos(α + β) = −\f{1}{10} and sin(α − β) = \f{3}{8}, where 0 < α < \f{π}{3} and 0 < β < \f{π}{4}. If tan 2α = \f{3(1 − r√{5})}{√{11}(s + √{5})}, r, s ∈ ℕ, then r + s is equal to ______.
sol: 2α = (α + β) + (α − β). tan(α + β) = −3√{11} (α + β in the 2nd quadrant), tan(α − β) = \f{3}{√{55}}.
The sum telescopes to tan^{−1}2^{11} − tan^{−1}1 = tan^{−1}2048 − \f{π}{4}.

pyq.q: Number of solutions of √{3}cos 2θ + 8 cos θ + 3√{3} = 0, θ ∈ [−3π, 2π] is :
sol: cos θ = −\f{1}{√{3}} twice per 2π; [−3π, 2π] has length 5π: count gives 5.

pyq.q: If S = {θ ∈ [−π, π] : cos θ cos\f{5θ}{2} = cos 7θ cos\f{7θ}{2}}, then n(S) is equal to ______.
sol: Product to sum: cos\f{7θ}{2} + cos\f{3θ}{2} = cos\f{21θ}{2} + cos\f{7θ}{2} → cos\f{3θ}{2} = cos\f{21θ}{2}.
\f{21θ}{2} = 2kπ ± \f{3θ}{2} → θ = \f{2kπ}{9} (9 values in [−π, π]) or θ = \f{kπ}{6} (13 values).

For the functions f(θ) = α tan^{2}θ + β cot^{2}θ, and g(θ) = α sin^{2}θ + β cos^{2}θ, α > β > 0, let min_{0<θ<π/2} f(θ) = max_{0<θ<π} g(θ). If the first term of a G.P. is (\f{α}{2β}), its common ratio is (\f{2β}{α}) and the sum of its first 10 terms is \f{m}{n}, gcd(m, n) = 1, then m + n is equal to ______.
sol: min f = 2√{αβ} (AM–GM); max g = α (since α > β).

pyq.q: If cot x = \f{5}{12} for some x ∈ (π, \f{3π}{2}), then sin 7x(cos\f{13x}{2} + sin\f{13x}{2}) + cos 7x(cos\f{13x}{2} − sin\f{13x}{2}) is equal to
sol: Regroup: (sin 7x cos\f{13x}{2} − cos 7x sin\f{13x}{2}) + (sin 7x sin\f{13x}{2} + cos 7x cos\f{13x}{2}) = sin\f{x}{2} + cos\f{x}{2}.

pyq.q: The number of elements in the set {x ∈ [0, 180°] : tan(x + 100°) = tan(x + 50°)tan x tan(x − 50°)} is ______.
sol: Write \f{tan(x + 100°)}{tan x} = \f{sin(x + 50°)sin(x − 50°)}{cos(x + 50°)cos(x − 50°)} = \f{cos 100° − cos 2x}{cos 100° + cos 2x}, then apply componendo–dividendo to both sides.

pyq.q: If k = tan(\f{π}{4} + \f{1}{2}cos^{−1}(\f{2}{3})) + tan(\f{1}{2}sin^{−1}(\f{2}{3})), then the number of solutions of the equation sin^{−1}(kx − 1) = sin^{−1}x − cos^{−1}x is ______.
sol: RHS = 2 sin^{−1}x − \f{π}{2}. Taking sine: 3x − 1 = −cos(2 sin^{−1}x) = 2x^{2} − 1 → x = 0 or \f{3}{2}.
Only x = 0 is valid (both sides −\f{π}{2}): 1 solution.

pyq.q: If the range of f(θ) = \f{sin^{4}θ + 3cos^{2}θ}{sin^{4}θ + cos^{2}θ}, θ ∈ ℝ is [α, β], then the sum of the infinite G.P., whose first term is 64 and the common ratio is \f{α}{β}, is equal to ______.
sol: f = 1 + \f{2cos^{2}θ}{sin^{4}θ + cos^{2}θ}; with c = cos^{2}θ: denominator (1 − c)^{2} + c = 1 − c + c^{2}.

pyq.q: Using the principal values of the inverse trigonometric functions, the sum of the maximum and the minimum values of 16((sec^{−1}x)^{2} + (cosec^{−1}x)^{2}) is :

words: Across distance of the unit-circle point
Angle unit with pi in it
Kind of value in the standard range
